features.description: Fix type unification so curried lambdas (\a. \b. expr) unify with multi-param functions ((a, b) -> c) in HOF arguments
acceptance_criteria: foldl(\acc. \cell. acc + cell, 0, [1,2,3]) type-checks and returns 6
Existing multi-param lambdas (\x y. x + y) unchanged
Full eval suite shows no regressions
features.notes: Added flattenFunc helper + curried flattening to all 3 unification paths (TFunc2↔TFunc2, TFunc2↔TFunc, TFunc↔TFunc2). 49 insertions, 15 deletions. 7 unit tests added.

features.description: Add member, dedup, intersect, union, difference to std/list using Go builtins with reflect.DeepEqual
acceptance_criteria: make test and make lint pass
features.notes: 5 builtins (member, dedup, intersect, union, difference) with reflect.DeepEqual fallback. 568 LOC added. 28 test cases pass with -count=20. Example file works end-to-end.
